reviews.title: Poor usability, configurability, and takes too long. No response from developers
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app regularly for about four months. It grows quickly from just a couple of minutes to requiring 6 to 8 minutes or more to do a session. There are no options to increase intensity and reduce the length of the sessions meaning you rapidly wind up needing to find about 30 minutes a day to keep up with this on top of that a number of the exercises are just simply poorly designed because of the interface to the app you have to keep it open and focused on it to be able to do this when you really can’t do much else other than sit there and maybe watch TV in short this becomes a huge time so I’m not convinced I’ve seen any improvement as the result of using this app. I’ve had no response to multiple feedback requests from the developer. And frankly, most of the exercises aren’t that hard you might as well just look up a couple of Keagle exercise exercises and decide how much time you’re going to spend doing this. You’ll get the same benefit without wasting any money Probably the most annoying is it lack any type of snooze or vacation mode so if you’re just in a situation where you know you’re not going to do it it’s going to remind you an annoying amount of times and then it’s actually going to automatically disable your notifications wipe them from the app and when you can get back to doing it, you get to go through the fun process of setting up all your reminders all over

reviews.title: Over-charged on renewal
reviews.text: The pricing policy in the pitch is really opaque.  You’ll be over-billed if you keep the app and they’ll grind you down with stupid answers from their no-customer support department if you try dispute it. Ultimately, you cancel the app, accept the over-billing because life if too short to fight that hard for a few bucks. And you hope karma will find them.

reviews.title: Lack of customer support
reviews.text: I’ve sent a couple of emails requesting assistance in having my account login info reset. And my request for help has fallen on deaf ears. You provide a email to contact for issues and concerns yet no one takes the initiative to respond. Sure had no problem with them taking my hard earned money. I will NOT be renewing any subscriptions when you are only concerned with how deep my pockets are. The proof is in the failed response(s) from this app/support team. Wish I could give a zero rating here. All these companies make it difficult to get a hold of anyone to assist.
